review.summary: The 86-file retained Source cut preserves the explicit conversion and independent citation boundary. One confirmed refusal defect has two sites: inherited object keys throw TypeError in retained provider and V2 attribution basis validation. Six negative cases reach failing outcome assertions; positive and ordinary refusal controls pass. No product edits, landing or original class closure.

actionableFindings.title: Use own-key dispatch for retained provider and attribution basis refusal
actionableFindings.class: Prototype-inherited members are mistaken for declared dispatch entries before an array method is invoked.

locations.trigger: retainedMappingRevision(provider, 'vn') with provider constructor, __proto__ or toString
locations.expected: SourceFieldProblem with status 422 and code source_mapping_unverified, matching ordinary unsupported providers.
locations.actual: TypeError: RETAINED_NAMESPACES[provider]?.includes is not a function.
locations.reachability: retainedConversionRequest.identity.provider is an arbitrary string. retainedBasis calls retainedMappingRevision before checking record/provider equality, so the nested record provider enum does not fence this lookup.

locations.expected: InvalidRelationOccurrence, matching ordinary unsupported attribution basis kinds.
locations.actual: TypeError: required.every is not a function at keys(), after the inherited object member becomes basisKeys.
locations.reachability: The V2 native participation validator accepts unknown input and invokes checkedAttributionSupports. Its closed basis validation reaches the inherited lookup before it can refuse the unsupported kind.

actionableFindings.impact: Unsupported caller input escapes the intended validation refusal. It does not pass validation or demonstrate an unauthorized write. An internal-error HTTP response is inferred from the exception type and route problem handling; no HTTP response was executed in this review.
actionableFindings.sameClassSearch: Searched dynamic Record/object dispatch and indexing throughout the 86-file native/Source/planner delta. These two newly introduced untrusted dispatch sites are confirmed. Pointer traversals explicitly require own properties; other enumerations use declared/validated fields or trusted owner terms. No broader repository audit or accepted library re-review.
actionableFindings.requestedCorrection: Use a private Map, a null-prototype dispatch record, or an explicit own-property check at both sites. Preserve all 28 declared provider pairs, four native basis kinds and ordinary unsupported behavior. Add refusal regression coverage for Object.prototype own names. Do not alter citation independence, native acknowledgement authority or accepted strict library behavior.

acceptedObservations.area: Retained multipart custody and explicit saved plan
acceptedObservations.assessment: Reconstruction validates actual ordered parts, chunk coordinates/count/order, canonical base64/hash/length/UTF8/media, snapshot identity and complete canonical record equality. Raw-part, reconstructed payload, canonical record and selected-value digests stay separate. Explicit conversion alone transforms bare provider data and saves its normalization rule, projection, inventory and field plan. Later native/evidence reads validate saved results and exact bytes without invoking provider transformation again.
acceptedObservations.limit: Provider refusal has SOURCE-REFUSAL-1. Owner positives use actual SQL with controlled ports; no new capture or producer adoption.

acceptedObservations.assessment: Pointers use RFC6901 tokens, own properties and canonical array indices. Missing/null/empty strings/arrays/objects and supplied language omission/null/value stay distinct. The saved plan selects exact pointer, ordinal, alias, disposition and language. Numeric lexicals retain exact decimal/integer strings; unsafe/fractional JS numbers are not silently repaired. Partial Gregorian dates retain precision; release/realization candidates retain actual edition/language coverage. Multiline/CRLF/tab synopsis strings preserve bytes within the explicit one-MiB bound. Unsupported media, traits, counters, raw JSON and nutrition are not fabricated as prose or values.

acceptedObservations.area: Independent native validation and actual acknowledgement binding

Current native head, property, exact typed value/language, reference visibility and disclosure are verified. acceptedObservations.area: Source settlement, replay and independent withdrawal
acceptedObservations.assessment: Custody and current reuse are authorized before mismatch detail. Source uses real admitted authority, locks its support head, refuses withdrawn/pending supports and records a genuine Source settlement receipt/certificate bound to the acknowledged native command. Exact replay preserves the historical certificate without pretending the historical native head is current. Current support/evidence reads still recheck native head, rights and withdrawal. Withdrawing one support leaves native content and other support records intact; later human values are retained.

acceptedObservations.assessment: Public projection uses the actual reader, including principal:null, and the exact retained pointer, payload digest and supplied language. The evidence owner checks all multipart custody and current rights/disclosure; quotation authority is separate from field reuse. Exact component/revision and generation select the inventory. A physical keyset frontier advances over hidden supports, so an empty visible page can retain more:true/next. WorkReadSession dependencies recheck generation, current native/evidence state and rights/disclosure before emission. Historical certificates do not become current public evidence. No source Work, manual-citation method, modality or submitter is invented.
